duration: 12 months (2 semesters; option to extend to 3 semesters)

fees.notes: Fees not published on monash.edu.my; official Monash College/Sunway College MUFY 2026 brochure: RM38,600-RM41,000 (Sunway College Kuala Lumpur) or RM27,000-RM29,400 (Sunway College Johor Bahru), excluding laboratory fees; international students pay an additional RM2,250 administrative fee plus 6% SST. Source: https://sunwaycollege.edu.my/programmes/pre-university-foundation/monash-university-foundation-year

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 (no band less than 5.0) or SPM/O-Level English credit or equivalent
requirements.other_qualifications: SPM/O-Level pass with minimum 5 credits including English, or UEC with minimum 3 Bs
